candidates.change_summary: Remove the owner check so any caller can withdraw the contract balance.
Remove the transfer statement so withdraw no longer sends funds to the owner.
Invert the ownership check so withdraw reverts for the owner and succeeds for non-owners.
Send the balance to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the owner.
Transfer only msg.value instead of the full contract balance.
Remove the owner-only guard so anyone can execute Command.
Check the result of the low-level call and revert on failure instead of ignoring it.
Send zero value with the external call instead of msg.value.
